releaseNotes: Fixed the update-command fixture to assert the contract that applies to the install it runs in: a git checkout dry-runs (exit 0, version + position report), while an installed runtime — the synced ~/.agents copy has no .git above it — refuses self-update by name (update.not_a_checkout) with the tag-pinning guidance. Both are the command working; the fixture previously demanded checkout behavior everywhere, which failed every runtime sync's audit at v0.151.0.

The fixture now mirrors update.ts's own environment detection (a .git directory or worktree file anywhere above the skill root) instead of guessing from context, so the same suite is honest in the repository, in CI, and in a synced runtime — the three places the audit actually runs.
